- FX rates (from `FxMeta`) are preloaded into a CloverDX **Lookup Table** named **`FxRatesLookup`**, keyed by `curr_iso`.
- The output metadata includes a `local_value` field (it must exist if you assign it).

```ctl
//#CTL2

// Expected output record (must be used on the Map output port)
// <Record name="PaymentLocal" fieldDelimiter=",">
//   <Field name="trans_ref" type="string"/>
//   <Field name="usd_value" type="decimal" scale = 2/>
//   <Field name="curr_iso" type="string"/>
//   <Field name="local_value" type="decimal" scale = 2/>
// </Record>

function integer transform() {
    // pass-through
    $out.0.trans_ref = $in.0.trans_ref;
    $out.0.usd_value = $in.0.usd_value;
    $out.0.curr_iso  = $in.0.curr_iso;

    // Lookup FX rate by currency ISO
    // FxRatesLookup returns an FxRate record or null if not found
    string key = nvl($in.0.curr_iso, "");
    FxRate fx = lookup(FxRatesLookup).get(key);

    // If FX row is missing (e.g., USD not present), default rate to 1
    decimal rate = ($in.0.curr_iso == "USD" && (isnull(fx) || isnull(fx.exch_rate))) ? 1D : (!isnull(fx) && !isnull(fx.exch_rate) ? fx.exch_rate : null);

    // Compute local value and round to 2 decimals
    $out.0.local_value = isnull($in.0.usd_value) || isnull(rate) ? null : round($in.0.usd_value * rate, 2);

    return OK;
}
```

Notes:
- The graph would typically load the FX CSV into a Lookup Table (key = `curr_iso`) before the Map runs.
- The Map stays single-input (Payments) and performs a per-record lookup against `FxRatesLookup`.

    FoodRiskRule rule = null;
    boolean found = false;

    if (!isnull($in.0.municipal_code) && !isnull($in.0.audit_date)) {

             prefixLength >= 0 && !found;
             prefixLength--) {

            string prefix = substring($in.0.municipal_code, 0, prefixLength);
            FoodRiskRule candidate = lookup(SouthAsiaFoodRiskLookup).get(
                $in.0.market_nation,
                prefix

                    && $in.0.audit_date >= candidate.rule_start
                    && (isnull(candidate.rule_end)
                        || $in.0.audit_date <= candidate.rule_end)) {
                    rule = candidate;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }

                candidate = lookup(SouthAsiaFoodRiskLookup).next();
            }
        }
    }

    if (isnull(rule)) {
        $out.0.supervising_authority = "PENDING_REVIEW";
        $out.0.applied_fee_rate = 0D;
        $out.0.compliance_fee = 0D;
        $out.0.audit_disposition = "MANUAL_CHECK";
        return ALL;

    $out.0.supervising_authority =
        $in.0.market_nation + ":" + rule.municipality_prefix;

    decimal feeRate = null;
    if ($in.0.refrigeration_alert || startsWith($in.0.food_category, "RAW_")) {
        feeRate = rule.high_risk_rate;
    } else if (contains($in.0.food_category, "READY_TO_EAT")) {
        feeRate = rule.packaged_food_rate;
    } else {
        feeRate = rule.baseline_fee_rate;

    $out.0.compliance_fee = round(

        2

        $out.0.audit_disposition = "ESCALATE";
    } else if ($out.0.compliance_fee == 0D) {
        $out.0.audit_disposition = "WAIVED";

function integer transform() {
    PolicyRec policy = lookup(CarrierBookingPolicyLookup).get($in.0.carrier);

    long transit = (policy != null) ? policy.days : 5L;
    decimal maxRebate = (policy != null) ? policy.max_rebate : 0D;
    string[] prefixes = (policy != null) ? policy.blocked_prefixes : [];

    $out.0.book_ref = $in.0.carrier + "-" + $in.0.res_code;
    $out.0.manifest = upperCase(trim($in.0.cargo));

    integer dash = indexOf($in.0.corridor, "-");
    $out.0.origin = (dash >= 0) ? substring($in.0.corridor, 0, dash) : $in.0.corridor;

    decimal confirmed = $in.0.listed;
    if (!isnull($in.0.agreed) && $in.0.agreed > 0D && $in.0.agreed <= $in.0.listed) {
        confirmed = $in.0.agreed;
    }
    $out.0.confirmed = round(confirmed, 2);

        && ((($in.0.listed - confirmed) / $in.0.listed) * 100D) > maxRebate);

    $out.0.capacity = (
        $in.0.avail_pallets <= 0L
        ? "NO_CAPACITY"
        : (
            $in.0.avail_pallets < $in.0.req_pallets
            ? "PARTIAL_CAPACITY"
            : "CAPACITY_CONFIRMED"
        )
    );

    long offset = (
        $out.0.capacity == "CAPACITY_CONFIRMED"
        ? transit
        : (
            $out.0.capacity == "PARTIAL_CAPACITY"
            ? transit + 2L
            : transit + 4L
        )
    );
    $out.0.delivery_on = dateAdd($in.0.collect_on, offset, day);

    string commodity = null;
    string doc = null;

        try {
            variant json = parseJson($in.0.cargo_json);
            if (json typeof map) {
                variant commVal = json["commodity"];
                if (commVal typeof string) {
                    commodity = cast(commVal, string);
                }

                variant docVal = json["mercosur_doc"];
                if (docVal typeof string) {
                    doc = cast(docVal, string);
                }
            }
        } catch (CTLException ex) {
            commodity = null;
            doc = null;
        }
